meta.title: Rehearsals demo
meta.description: Installs Rehearsals with two demo rehearsals, one for the front end and one for wp-admin, and runs them.
meta.author: Automattic

steps.command: wp rehearsal save /tmp/rehearsal-front-end.json --title="Front end: the Hello world! post opens"
wp rehearsal save /tmp/rehearsal-back-end.json --title="Back end: a category is added (changes categories)"

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Playground only: the first time Tools > Rehearsal opens, run the demo rehearsals straight away.
 * Once a run is saved, the screen opens normally.
 */
add_action( 'load-tools_page_rehearsal', function () {
	if ( isset( $_GET['run'] ) || ! class_exists( 'Rehearsal_Share' ) ) {
		return;
	}
	if ( get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'rehearsal_run', 'post_status' => 'any', 'numberposts' => 1, 'fields' => 'ids' ) ) ) {
		return;
	}
	$ids = get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'rehearsal', 'numberposts' => -1, 'orderby' => 'ID', 'order' => 'ASC', 'fields' => 'ids' ) );
	if ( $ids ) {
		wp_safe_redirect( Rehearsal_Share::run_url( $ids, 'playground' ) );
		exit;
	}
} );
